metadata.description: The Bug Ball is about to begin, but four ladybugs have lost their Valentines! In this interactive adventure, kids search for the missing cards hidden among festive decorations. Using the Valentine’s Decor Map, they choose where to look next, making each game unique. With fun clues, immersive storytelling, and engaging problem-solving, this audio keeps kids entertained while building critical thinking skills. Can you find all four valentines in time for the party? Let the search begin!
